items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: my cousin Harold, Harold Newchurch... he used to play all the house parties around Miami.

ctx.x: Uh huh. What were some of the first orchestras around town that you remember?
Well, I had a cousin of mine who was a trumpet player -- my cousin Harold, Harold Newchurch, and he used to play all the house parties around Miami.
Oh? What was his instrument? Piano?
